voice.speaker: assembly-of-gods-1
voice.caption: The gods take their places in a widening ring. Poseidon’s seat remains empty.

voice.speaker: athena
voice.caption: Father Zeus, let Aegisthus lie in the ruin he earned. It is Odysseus my heart breaks for, wise, unlucky Odysseus, held against his will on Calypso's island, longing only for the sight of smoke rising from his own hearth. Has he not paid you sacrifice enough on the plain of Troy, Olympian?

voice.speaker: zeus
voice.caption: My child, how could I forget godlike Odysseus? It is Poseidon the earth-shaker who rages without rest for the blinding of his Cyclops son, and drives that man from his homecoming. But come, let us here shape his return; one god cannot hold out against us all.

keys.beat: The Olympian gods assemble while Poseidon is absent among the Ethiopians.
Athena redirects the council toward Odysseus, captive on Calypso's island.
Zeus names Poseidon's anger as the obstacle and permits a plan for Odysseus's return.
